name: Shipment and Payment Issue Explanation Automation

parameters.query:
SELECT
    sd.sh_id AS shipment_id,
    c.c_name AS customer_name,
    c.c_type AS customer_type,
    sd.sh_content,
    sd.sh_domain,
    sd.ser_type,
    sd.sh_weight,
    sd.sh_charges,
    st.current_status,
    st.sent_date,
    st.delivery_date,
    p.amount,
    p.payment_status,
    p.payment_mode,
    p.payment_date
FROM shipment_details sd
LEFT JOIN customer c ON sd.c_id = c.c_id
LEFT JOIN status st ON sd.sh_id = st.sh_id
LEFT JOIN payment_details p ON sd.sh_id = p.sh_id
WHERE sd.sh_id = {{ $json.body.shipment_id }};
